reasons: CS4246 needs CS3263 or CS3243, which is not completed; CS3235 needs CS2107, also not completed.
Adding CS3263 and CS2107 makes 7 courses for semesters 7-8, but at most 3 modules per semester allows only 6.
CS3213 is only offered in Semester 2, and CS4246 needs its prerequisite in a strictly earlier semester, so the remaining courses cannot fit.
